sources.finding: Public technical page gives stage dimensions and a loading opening connecting the scene shop. It still does not define SCENE/STUDI walls. Current recheck yielded no public numbered shop plan.

Official October2023 environmental notice describes replacement bracing and strengthened beams/columns in Theatre and Shop. No exact classroom identity or room-perimeter drawing was retrieved from the indexed notice.
January2026 UCOP report printed page48 says the combined CUP and Mandell Weiss seismic projects are complete. This is renovation-history evidence only, not an interior plan.

Venue Managers Council Technical Specifications directory was listed read-only by teammate public_plan_sources using the Drive connector. It contained only an Epstein Family Amphitheater technical-specification shortcut, no Wagner/Weiss/Galbraith drawing. Separate Safety directory redirected to login and was not pursued.

limitations: The theater stage, scene shop, costume shop and unidentified schedule STUDI must not be treated as interchangeable.
A third-party bid listing calls a package abandoned while the newer UCOP report says the projects are complete; the official report is retained for project status, neither supplies geometry.
